entries.subject: ESA/Hubble potw1346a
entries.finding: Best image of bright quasar 3C 273: Hubble WFPC2, two filters: blue light at 450 nm and visible light at 606 nm; 705 × 696 px over 1.17 arcmin. The file's embedded tags, used as they are: 0.09967 arcsec per pixel, north 159.6° right of vertical, centre 187.277387°, 2.052926°. They place the catalogue position on the bright core, 11 px from the frame's centre. Not measured against Gaia: the frame holds too few stars.
